survey: A folding camp chair on a pale tabletop-like floor slab against an orange wall. The camera is above and to the front-left, and the chair is turned so its right side is nearer the viewer; the vanishing point for its front-to-back width is off to the left. Base: a rectangle of tubes with ball feet sitting flat on the floor. The front bar and back bar slope down to the right and converge toward the left, and the side bars recede up and to the right, matching the floor's angle. Side X-legs: on each side, one tube runs from the seat's front corner down to the back foot. A second tube continues from the back upright down to the front foot. The two cross at a grey pivot joint, and the joint on the nearer right side sits lower in the picture, as it should. Seat: a green canvas sling between a front and a back tube, seen from above. Its front tube sits roughly parallel to the base's front bar, sloping a little less because it is closer to eye level. Backrest: a canvas panel between two vertical uprights and a top tube. Its top edge rises slightly to the right and its bottom edge falls slightly, which fits a horizon running through the backrest with the same left vanishing point. The uprights stay vertical. The cast shadow falls to the back-right on the floor plane. The tube end caps are round and match the direction of their tubes.
